subject.title: Control UI: Debug snapshot refresh has no progress indicator and silently fails when disconnected

question: Should maintainers adopt or close the open conflicting fork PR before ClawSweeper queues a fresh Debug Snapshots fix from this issue?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but an open fork PR still references this issue with closing syntax and uses the same stale conflicting head as the closed same-repo PR, so automation should not create a duplicate until maintainers choose the path.

options.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
options.body: Close or supersede the stale conflicting fork PR, then allow a new narrow Control UI fix against the current Debug page structure.

options.title: Adopt and rebase the fork PR
options.body: Have a maintainer or contributor rebase the fork branch, move it to the current Debug page files, add localized copy, and supply visual proof before review.

recommendation.title: Close fork path and queue fresh fix
recommendation.body: Close or supersede the stale conflicting fork PR, then allow a new narrow Control UI fix against the current Debug page structure.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter has the strongest history on the original Debug controller/view wiring and is the best available routing owner from the feature history.
